title: July 2026 Monthly Report

metrics.label: Monthly character
metrics.value: A rapid reset after an AI- and semiconductor-led market

metrics.label: Key divergence
metrics.value: TOPIX held up better than the Nikkei 225

sections.heading: 1. July in review: expectations were repriced
body: Japanese equities entered July with strong momentum in AI, semiconductor, and memory-related shares, but those areas later corrected sharply as investors reassessed the durability and cost of AI investment.

TOPIX was relatively firmer than the Nikkei 225, suggesting that selling was concentrated in high-priced semiconductor leaders rather than reflecting a uniform deterioration across all listed companies.
A rebound near month-end improved sentiment, but volatility remained high and did not by itself establish a stable uptrend.

sections.heading: 2. Theme rotation
body: Capital moved unevenly between AI-related growth themes and areas such as financials, defense, infrastructure, and domestic demand.

The month demonstrated why index performance alone is insufficient. Breadth, volume, trading value, and the number of participating stocks are necessary to judge whether a theme is genuinely strengthening.

sections.heading: 3. August checklist
body: Watch earnings revisions, order momentum, capital-expenditure guidance, and whether rebounds are supported by broader participation.
A durable recovery would require improving fundamentals and trading breadth, not merely short covering in a small number of large-cap names.

disclaimer: This report is a market review based on public information and does not recommend the purchase or sale of any security.
